ledger.x: 1810: Berau divides and Gunung Tabur begins.
1810: Gunung Tabur takes its half of the divided Berau Sultanate: 'the land north of the Berau River and both banks of the Segah River'; Sambaliung took the west and south.
1834: the Dutch conquer Berau and the sultan signs an agreement.
December 1949 to 1960: Gunung Tabur continues as a 'Swapraja di bawah Daerah Istimewa Berau' (self-governing region under the Berau Special Region) inside Indonesia.

certainty.note: The page names the land only as north of the Berau river and both banks of the Segah, between Bulungan, Sambaliung and the Sulawesi Sea; no outline.
